claims: Sean Penn won the 2026 Oscar for Best Supporting Actor for his role as Colonel Steven J. Lockjaw in One Battle After Another.
Sean Penn's 2026 Oscar win marks his third Academy Award win.
Benicio del Toro is Sean Penn's co-star in One Battle After Another.
Sean Penn (One Battle After Another) won the 2026 Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor.
Benicio del Toro (One Battle After Another) was nominated for the 2026 Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor.
Jacob Elordi (Frankenstein) was nominated for the 2026 Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor.
Delroy Lindo (Sinners) was nominated for the 2026 Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor.
Stellan Skarsgård (Sentimental Value) was nominated for the 2026 Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor.
The One Battle After Another cast garnered multiple acting nominations.
